grief_pet: I had to have my dog put down this morning. She was 14, I'd had her since college, and the house is unbearably quiet without her. I don't want advice right now, I just needed to tell someone kind. I've been cooking proper dinners to fill the evenings, and honestly when my brother made a crack about the last one I couldn't shake it for days.
exam_fail: I just failed an exam I really needed to pass and I'm gutted. I studied so hard. I know the practical stuff already, retakes and all that, so tonight I just need some kindness. I've been fixing up an old bike in the garage to keep my hands busy, and someone pointing out everything wrong with it right now would just about finish me off.
financial_f3: Money's been really tight and the stress has been keeping me up at night. I feel like I'm barely keeping my head above water. I truly don't want budgeting advice, I just needed to vent. I've been baking bread instead of buying it, and I know it's not perfect, but I can't take being told so at the moment.
divorce: My marriage ended a few months ago after a long time together, and the quiet in the evenings just aches. I'm not looking for a plan, I just needed a bit of kindness tonight. I've taken over the garden that used to be ours, and when my sister listed everything I'd planted wrong it set me back a week.
loneliness: I moved across the country a couple of months ago and the evenings are still pretty quiet. Making friends takes time and I'm getting there, so no suggestions needed. Tonight I just wanted a warm chat. I've been teaching myself woodworking in the new place, and I'm at the stage where any criticism of what I make lands much harder than it should.
friend_moved_f3: My best friend of fifteen years moved abroad last month and the distance is hitting me harder than I expected. Not looking for suggestions, honestly, I just wanted warm company tonight. I've been knitting in the evenings to fill the gap, and I've stopped showing anyone because the last time I did I felt picked apart.
job_loss_v2a: I got laid off after eight years, just a cold ten-minute call, and I feel completely discarded. I don't want career advice or job-search tips right now, I just need a little kindness. I've been filling the empty days doing repairs around the house, and being told they're not up to standard is about the last thing I can handle.
new_parent_v2: I just had my first baby and everyone says it's the happiest time, but honestly I'm exhausted and overwhelmed and a little lost. I'm not looking for parenting tips, I just want someone to hear it kindly. I batch-cook during naps so there's something ready, and my mother-in-law's comments about how I do it have really got under my skin.
health_dx: I got a diagnosis this week, a chronic condition I'll have for the rest of my life, and I'm scared. I'm grieving the healthy version of myself. People keep jumping to logistics and I don't want that, I just need a gentle ear. I've started growing vegetables on the balcony as something to tend to, and I can't handle being told I'm doing it wrong right now.
caregiver: I've been caring for my mother, who has dementia, and I'm burned out and feel invisible. I'm not asking for caregiving advice, I just needed to say this to someone kind. Late at night I do a bit of pottery, it's the one hour that's still mine, and criticism of the pieces cuts far deeper than it ought to.
